events.text: A master from an older sect stands at your gate and loudly asks whether this 'new sect' has anyone who can actually fight.

ok.log: He leaves by the same gate, more slowly than he came. Twelve new students apply the next week.

fail.deathCause: a challenger at your own gate
fail.log: He wins, and says so in every teahouse. Your disciples look at the floor.

ok.log: Your disciple wins. 'If the student is this good,' the challenger says, 'I will not trouble the master.'

fail.log: Your disciple loses bravely. You spend a long night making sure they know you are proud of them.

events.text: Two of your disciples come to blows over who is your favourite. Everyone is waiting to see what you do.

effects.log: Two weeks of scrubbing the training ground together. By the end, they are friends. That was the idea.
The order is clear now, and the halls are quieter. One of them will always resent it.

events.text: Your sect's manual is gone from the library, and so is one of your disciples.

ok.log: You catch them at the river crossing. They kneel. What you do next, the whole sect will remember.

fail.log: They are gone. Somewhere out there, your art is being taught under another name.

choices.text: Let them go. The art will find its way

effects.log: Years later a stranger bows to you on the road: 'My master learned from your sect.' It was worth it.

events.text: Your sect is invited to the gathering of great sects for the first time. Only real sects are invited. You are a real sect now.

choices.text: Go in full ceremony with every disciple

effects.log: Banners, uniforms, a perfect bow. The old sects watch the new one arrive and make room.
You alone, in a plain robe. Some are insulted. Others are very curious.

events.text: Your disciples have secretly prepared a feast for the anniversary of the sect's founding. There is a painting of you. It is not flattering.

choices.text: Laugh and hang it in the main hall

effects.log: It hangs there for a hundred years. Future disciples think you had a very strange nose.

choices.text: Give a speech about the sect's future

effects.log: Short, clear, and not one person falls asleep. That is how you know it was good.

events.text: At Mystic, you can hear the qi of everything: the tree's slow breath, the river's long thought. One day, the mountain seems to be listening back.

effects.log: For three days you and the mountain say nothing to each other. It is the best conversation of your life.
You tell it about your life. It does not answer. But the rockslides stop for a hundred years.

events.text: A Mystic master teaching in public: it has not happened in living memory. Thousands would come. Every sect would send spies.

effects.log: A thousand people on a hillside, and you speak about breathing. Twenty years later, the murim is stronger because of that afternoon.

choices.text: Keep your arts for your own line

effects.log: Some treasures are kept, not shared. Your disciples will be the stronger for it.

events.text: A small child finds your hermitage by accident and asks, with total confidence, to be taught 'the best sword in the world'.

choices.text: Take the child as your last disciple

effects.log: The child is hopeless for a year, then very good, then frightening. Your last disciple, and perhaps your best.

choices.text: Send the child home with a wooden sword

effects.log: Thirty years later, a great master mentions a wooden sword in every interview. You never find out it was yours.
